scenarios.name: coal_supply_disruption
scenarios.description: Major coal supply disruption due to export ban reversal, mining accidents, or logistics failure. Indonesia relies on coal for 61.7% of electricity generation.
scenarios.trigger: Coal mine flooding / export policy shift / rail logistics collapse

scenarios.name: extreme_heat_wave
scenarios.description: Prolonged El Niño driven heatwave pushes temperatures above 38°C across Java. AC demand surges while hydro output drops due to drought.
scenarios.trigger: El Niño event / climate change amplification

scenarios.name: grid_cascade_failure
scenarios.description: Cascading grid failure triggered by transmission line fault on the Java-Bali interconnected system affecting 150M+ people.
scenarios.trigger: Transmission line failure / transformer overload / cyberattack

scenarios.name: natural_gas_price_shock
scenarios.description: Global LNG price spike (3x) makes gas-fired generation uneconomic. Gas plants reduce output; coal plants cannot ramp fast enough.

scenarios.name: renewable_transition_gap
scenarios.description: Rapid coal plant retirements outpace renewable + storage buildout. Structural capacity shortfall emerges during evening peak.
scenarios.trigger: Policy-driven coal retirement without adequate replacement
